crew.overview: When a hopelessly romantic high school senior falls for a mysterious new classmate, it sets them both on an unexpected journey that teaches them about love, loss, and most importantly themselves.
crew.title: Chemical Hearts

details.biography: Stephen James Taylor (born September 28, 1954) is an American composer best known for his film and TV scores. He has scored several films for directors Charles Burnett and Robert Townsend and numerous animated television shows. He has been nominated for four Emmy Awards for his work on the television film Brother Future and the series Timon & Bumbaa, I'll Fly Away, and Raw Toonage.
details.name: Stephen James Taylor
